evidence.observation: The opening names Jamie, the target role, and the operating-structure value proposition, then provides direct paths to selected work, resume, and contact.

Jamie's co-founder, project-manager, planning, and documentation account is explicitly attributed to his approved resume. His presenter role and the four affirmative Board votes are separately supported by the CCED Board packet.

The municipal sequence is properly divided: the Council record documents adoption and passage; the resolution accepts the recommendation and authorizes negotiations; the ordinance appropriates the amount. The page states that appropriation is not agreement execution, disbursement, receipt, expenditure, or completion.
The later record documents project withdrawal and reappropriation of unused funds without assigning a reason or individual responsibility.

Six ordered source records distinguish the resume, Board packet, Council meeting record, resolution, appropriation ordinance, and later reappropriation ordinance. Claim-level citations and does-not-establish boundaries make support and stopping points inspectable.
Headings preserve navigation, but the long chronology, numerous source notes, and repeated boundary explanations prevent exceptional one-pass concision.
Jamie is visible as the resume-attributed co-founder and project manager and as the officially named presenter, while Board and Council actions retain institutional ownership.
The portfolio still lacks an approved, inspectable project screenshot or primary work artifact. This is the explicit existing application-stage deferral.

All ten inspected routes returned 200 without desktop, mobile, or 200%-equivalent reflow overflow. Twenty-four traversed controls showed visible focus, and citation targets and backlinks remained keyboard accessible.
Resume download, contact paths, canonical metadata, Open Graph data, and Twitter card metadata are present under staging defaults.

Repository integrity, baseline comparison, public safety, claim and citation integrity, resume consistency, routes, application paths, and responsive evidence passed; production controls remain deferred.

smallestDefensiblePatch: After rights and public-safety review, add one approved, inspectable project artifact image with an adjacent ownership and source-boundary caption; do not use municipal outcome records as a substitute for evidence of Jamie's own work.
